CBULK.stands_in_for: every bulk and decoupling capacitance on the rail as one ideal capacitor, with no ESR, no ESL and no DC bias derating

RLED.stands_in_for: the LED array's aggregate draw as a fixed resistance at its worst-case current; a constant-current load droops no further than this

RPATH.stands_in_for: the series resistance of the cable, the receptacle contacts and the board copper between the receptacle and the LED ring, as a design budget

SRC.stands_in_for: the regulator's output at the low end of the declared rail, as an ideal source; its transient response to a load step is not modelled, and the datasheet states no load-transient figure to model it from

SWITCH.stands_in_for: the instant at which firmware turns the whole ring on, as an ideal switch with no on-resistance

basis.detail: the rail is held at the low end of its declared range, the source minimum less the regulator's dropout at the declared port budget, so it can only be higher than this in service
